items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: I don't know how we got to be such friends, but anyway... And we got to be good friends.

ctx.x: In New York. Because when I went out on the road with Jelly, I didn't take my transfer up. So I come in town, and the only musician I knew was Freddy Jenkins. I don't know how we got to be such friends, but anyway...
Freddy Jenkins was a trumpet player.
